variety_description: Mid-early duration, medium height variety with long slender grain suitable for the irrigated medium ecosystem. Developed and released by NRRI, Cuttack in 2000 for cultivation in West Bengal.  Vast seasonal adaptability and can be grown under all rice growing seasons. Being early in maturity, good grain size, and better cooking quality, it is a preferred variety to grow in West Bengal. Tolerant to lodging and major leaf and sheath diseases.
